$comment: Canonical Project State Registry (2026-08-17 full audit, §29). Single source of current state for every major Human OS artifact. README/ROADMAP/manifest/CHANGELOG must agree with this file; on divergence THIS FILE wins and the others are corrected. Maturity vocabulary: SOURCE_ONLY (spec exists, no code), DIGESTED (source digested + ADRs, no code), SKELETON (types/config-required, no behavior defaults), ALPHA_SLICE (bounded executable slice with tests), ALPHA (substantially implemented, not hardened), UX_PROTOTYPE (app-side mock), ABSENT (no confirmed canonical artifact). source_of_truth points at the artifact that governs meaning; implementation_modules at executable code.
